stories.title: FIDE Chess World Cup, Goa (31 Oct–27 Nov)
stories.body: Uzbekistan's 19-year-old Javokhir Sindarov beat China's Wei Yi in tiebreaks to become the youngest-ever champion; the trophy was renamed the Viswanathan Anand Cup, and the top three qualified for the 2026 Candidates.
